critical_findings.tfidf_formal_suite_174k_complete: 8 TF-IDF representations evaluated at full 174k scale (frozen harness v3, HNSW artifact fixed). Citation-based modes (cited_decisions_tfidf, outcome_hybrid_0.5/0.7) PASS both adversarial gates (LangDom~0.48, JP~0.63-0.73). Text-based modes (full_text_tfidf_light, regeste_tfidf) also PASS adversarial (LangDom~0.48-0.50, JP~0.63-0.71). FUNDAMENTAL TWO-MODE TRADEOFF PERSISTS: citation-based fail cross-language/hierarchy/boilerplate; text-based fail cross-language/hierarchy/boilerplate. NO single mode dominates all benchmarks.
critical_findings.dense_embeddings_19year_checkpoint: 19-year checkpoint (2000-2018, ~122,015 decisions) complete with center_projected (768/64/128dim). center_projected_768: FAIL both gates (LangDom=0.983, JP=0.047). center_projected_64: FAIL jurist gate (LangDom=0.860, JP=0.369). ALL dense modes fail adversarial at 19-year scale. Scale increase from 15-year (91k) to 19-year (122k) did not fix dense mode failures.
critical_findings.source_data_gap_2019_2020_2026: bger_YYYY.jsonl source files for 2019 and 2020-2026 MISSING from accepted state (/tmp/lex_accepted/corpus/corpus/normalization/canonical/). Only 50 decisions/year available for 2020-2024 in raw acquisition. Year 2019 has 7,665 decisions in metadata but 0 embeddings. Full 174k dense embeddings BLOCKED until source data restored or regenerated.
critical_findings.linear_citation_concat_19year_BREAKTHROU: Tested on 19-year subset (122k): LangDom=0.767 PASS, JP=0.545 PASS. FIRST linear combination to pass BOTH adversarial gates! Scale from 15-year (91k, JP=0.481 FAIL) to 19-year (122k, JP=0.545 PASS) crossed the 0.5 jurist preference threshold. Cross-language: zero_shot_nmi=0.203 (vs 0.021 for citation TF-IDF), lang_specific_nmi=0.189 (vs 0.038). Partially breaks two-mode tradeoff.
critical_findings.linear_hybrid05_concat_19year_BREAKTHROU: Tested on 19-year subset (122k): LangDom=0.778 PASS, JP=0.540 PASS. Also passes both adversarial gates. Combines center_projected_64 + cited_decisions_tfidf_outcome_hybrid_0.5. Cross-language: zero_shot_nmi=0.209, lang_specific_nmi=0.282. Similar tradeoff profile to linear_citation_concat.
critical_findings.linear_combinations_15year_vs_19year: 15-year: both FAIL jurist gate (JP=0.481, 0.473). 19-year: both PASS (JP=0.545, 0.540). Demonstrates POSITIVE SCALE DEPENDENCE for linear combinations — larger corpus improves jurist preference. Contrast: dense-only modes show negative or flat scale dependence.
critical_findings.section_crosslingual_1000sample: Section-specific evaluation on 1000-decision sample: sachverhalt (n=359) center_projected_64 invariance_gap=0.187, zero_shot_mean_nmi=0.189 (FAIL); erwaegungen (n=510) center_projected_64 invariance_gap=0.452, zero_shot_mean_nmi=0.065 (FAIL). Cross-lingual transfer remains weak for all dense modes. Section coverage limited by signal extraction availability.
critical_findings.citation_heritage_infrastructure: Citation graph resolution: 2,019/2,105 (95.9%) resolved. Citation heritage benchmark ready with 1,020 positive/negative pairs. Only 174 decisions (0.1%) in 174k corpus have outgoing citations — extremely sparse.
critical_findings.v14_linear_citation_concat_reproduced: v14 independent rerun CONFIRMS v13: linear_citation_concat (equal concat metric-learning+citation) meets frozen success rule (mean_delta=+0.0392, paired_std=0.0212). Promoted to REPRODUCED tier. linear_hybrid05_concat FAILS stability (paired_std=0.042 > 0.03). MLP combinations UNSTABLE. Static concat beats learned combinations.
critical_findings.jurist_pref_ceiling_confirmed: NO representation achieves JuristPref > 0.7 on holdout — systematic ceiling at ~0.605 (pre-trained) or ~0.53 (true OOS). JuristPref > 0.7 requires fundamentally new approaches.
critical_findings.two_mode_tradeoff_fundamental: Citation-based (High-Advantage: LangDom~0.5, JP~0.58, CiteIndep~14%) vs Semantic/Metric-learning (High-Purity: LangDom~0.6, JP~0.53, CiteIndep~35-37%). Cross-mode combinations (linear_citation_concat) PARTIALLY break tradeoff: PASS both adversarial gates at 19-year scale with moderate cross-language transfer, but JP (0.54) still below citation TF-IDF (0.72).
critical_findings.center_projected_fails_174k_scale: Per audit CYCLE_36518989087: center_projected baselines FAIL jurist gate at 174k (JP=0.39-0.42). Metric learning necessary for legal navigation at scale.
critical_findings.boilerplate_resistance_negative_all: Boilerplate resistance NEGATIVE for ALL representations (resistance_score ≈ -0.74 to -0.92) — confirms proxy measures language dominance/cross-lingual alignment failure, not procedural boilerplate.
